name: Wyvill and Kunii's Ray Tracing / Neighbor Finding Algorithm
definition: A ray tracing algorithm for hierarchical spatial structures (quadtrees/octrees) that determines the next intersected cell by calculating a point guaranteed to lie inside it, rather than computing a direction vector.
summary: Wyvill and Kunii's algorithm finds the next intersected cell in hierarchical structures by calculating a specific exit point via rational t-values, avoiding explicit direction vector computation.
